text: Layout results shall be nonnegative mathematical quantities fitting the unsigned result width. Invalid paths shall be rejected structurally; unsupported layouts and unrepresentable results shall be rejected at binding without truncation. Unbound numeric results shall remain unresolved.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
